retained_context: The circuit models use classical numerical emulation of two qubits. Five separate parameter banks are available, and the frozen router selects the bank used for an input. The experiment does not test a large language model, a quantum processor, learned semantic priorities, retention policies, online adaptation or the full proposed architecture. Q-Path Multiplier (ETEL) schedules complete fits; its logical slots do not create additional scientific states or model capacity.

The recorded host is an MSI Stealth A18 AI+ A3XWJG with an AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 processor, 12 physical cores and 24 logical processors. Windows reports 67,772,469,248 bytes of physical memory (approximately 63.1 GiB). The operating system is Windows 11 Pro, version 10.0.26300, build 26300. The study uses the CPU; the GPU is not used.

Each session contains 640 selected models, 256 additional compiled circuit representations, 2,688 conditions and 40,320 timed calls. The independent audit checks all 120,960 raw timed rows across three sessions. The 16,128 warmups are committed counters supported by the producer loop; individual warmup call times are not retained or independently observed. Each timed trial contains one complete raw-input call. Memory was sampled at start/end and at all 32 population blocks.

Resource availability in the following table follows the inner phase-summary records. The independent timing audit does not retain whole-process resource counters in its inner summary, hence the two Unrecorded cells. Its separate external completion records 270.890625 seconds of process CPU and a maximum live-sampled peak working-set observation of 173,367,296 bytes. Those broader counters are reported again in the operations record below. The memory observation is sampled, not a guaranteed final process peak. Nested counters overlap and must not be added.

Inner counters start after phase release verification and may exclude imports, source/hash validation and output preflight. Whole-process CPU and peak working set are shown only where explicitly recorded through the sampling point. Unrecorded is not zero. Peak RAM is process working set, not device memory or memory allocated solely to one model. These nested counters must not be added to each other. External invocation wall times belong to the separate operations supplement and must not be added to inner wall time. Construction and component probes are single instrumented observations that perturb execution.

Medians across 192 single instrumented observations per arm: 64 models across four tasks, each observed in all three sessions. These are loading diagnostics, not primary resident-call latencies, and their sum is not a measured cold-start latency. All model-specific loading and component records, session identities, memory samples and full scopes are retained in DERIVED_EVIDENCE.json.
